subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool uptick — request for executive review of discount/credits
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan.park@astranova.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.s@astranova.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal questions + request to expand reserved pool at renewal

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting ready to lock in our annual renewal and have a couple of asks: we want to increase our Dedicated reserved pool from 8 A100s to 12 A100s effective Jan 1, 2027 to support an expected Q1 burst across our personalization service.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide a one-time onboarding credit or renewal discount to offset the additional three months of ramp cost?
- We need a throughput guarantee on per-request latency at 95th pct; can that be committed in the SLA for the expanded pool?

Maya (cc’d) is handling procurement. She’ll need the updated SOW + a formal quote with any proposed credit/discount and the SLA language.

Thanks — Evan

--
Evan Park
Director of Platform
AstraNova Inc.
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@astranova.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.s@astranova.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal questions + request to expand reserved pool at renewal

Evan — thanks for the note. This is doable but there are two moving pieces: 1) the pricing adjustment for the additional capacity, and 2) an SLA addendum for the 95th latency window on the expanded pool.

I’ve looped in Marissa (sales lead for this account) and copied our solutions lead (Karthik) to confirm the pool config. Marissa — can you draft the updated quote and mark any discretionary renewal credit you’re prepared to approve? Karthik — can your team validate the latency target is realistic with a 12-A100 reserved pool and outline any gating constraints (workload mix, batching, KV cache expectations)?

Maya — we’ll follow up with the SOW and a formal quote tomorrow. If you have a target credit % you need to get to procurement signoff, please share it.

Best,
Rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal questions + request to expand reserved pool at renewal

Quick draft for internal review.

Summary: AstraNova requests +4 A100 equivalent (current 8 -> requested 12) starting 2027-01-01; estimated ARR delta = $1.18M.

Recommended commercial approach:
- Standard list pricing for the incremental capacity applied to renewal term.
- One-time renewal concession: 7% credit on incremental committed spend for first 12 months (front-loaded as a contra invoice over Q1).
- Add SLA addendum: 95th latency commitment of <= 120ms for Gen-2 text-generation endpoints running at their current traffic profile; automatic fallback policy to smaller model-family only after cross-region failover.

Rationale: 7% gives customer ~82k in first-year concession; preserves margin while reducing churn risk for an account at scale.

Attachments: reserved_pool_config_4xA100.xlsx (pool layout), discount_model_calc.csv (calcs).

Needs exec approval for a concession at/above 7% or alternative credit structure.

Marissa
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal questions + request to expand reserved pool at renewal

FWIW from engineering: a 12-A100 reserved pool should comfortably meet their QPS if the traffic profile stays GPU-dominated text-generation with KV cache enabled. Two caveats:
1) If AstraNova increases peak sequence length beyond current norms we may see 95th pct variance; recommend we bake an Ops-run load test during the 30-day pre-rollout window.
2) We should offer a measurable ramp—e.g., phase additional capacity over 3 weeks with telemetry checks to commit SLA.

SLA language draft (high level):
- 95th percentile latency guarantee <= 120ms for specified endpoints under declared workload.
- If sustained breach (>3 days), Redwood will provide a credit equal to 10% of monthly committed spend for impacted routes until resolved.

I’ll coordinate a quick runbook and include results in the SOW.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Exec review request: AstraNova renewal concession (need sign-off)

Team — we need quick executive sign-off for the concession plan before I send the formal quote to AstraNova procurement this afternoon.

Proposal (recap):
- Incremental pool: +4 A100-equivalent (8->12), start 2027-01-01, 12-month committed term.
- One-time renewal concession: 7% credit on incremental committed spend for first 12 months (applied as contra in Q1 invoices).
- SLA: 95th <= 120ms with credit remediation (10% monthly credit) for sustained breach.
- Operational: 30-day pre-rollout load test + phased capacity ramp.

Requested approvals:
- Sergio: margin ok? any constraints on offering 7%?
- Neha: legal sign-off on SLA remediation language?

I’ve attached the redline for the SOW and the pricing calc. If we can’t meet 7% today, what’s the threshold you’d approve without VP sign-off?

Thanks — I’ll be on standby for edits.

Rachel
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec review request: AstraNova renewal concession (need sign-off)

Rachel / team — I ran the numbers. 7% on incremental ARR of $1.18M yields ~82.6k first-year concession; that’s acceptable within our strategic renewal playbook for a customer of AstraNova’s size and risk profile. Approve the 7% concession.

Two notes:
- Keep legal language conservative around SLA credit stacking (no double-dipping across remedies).
- If the customer pushes for deeper front-loaded credits, route to VP Sales (Marissa please flag).

I’ll sign electronically on the Finance side once the SOW is final.

Sergio
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
